subject: Tool note: decide accepts a decision depending on itself
body: Exact case: two decide calls in one shell. The first failed on title length; the second ran with --depends-on D-contracts-007 and got the id D-contracts-007 itself. validate passed. Suggest decide rejects --depends-on or --supersedes naming the id being written. I noted it in D-contracts-008's context; the intended dependency was the profile decision. Also: no lane owns a root package-lock.json. I installed with --no-package-lock and committed none. If you want a lockfile, it's yours.
